xBRIEFInfo.description: Markdown ingest and shared finding model

narratives.Overview: Ingest single Markdown chapters and chapter folders. Define the Finding model used by every engine: location, severity, category, message, suggested fix, engine source. Companion uses one chapter; analyze discovers chapters and runs chapter-by-chapter. Traces: FR-INGEST-1, FR-FIND-1.
narratives.Acceptance: Single .md and folder of .md chapters load with stable chapter order. Finding model serializes to JSON. Invalid paths return clear errors without crashing.

narrative.Overview: Discover and order Markdown chapters from a file or folder (Ghostreader-style naming habits).
Typed Finding with location (chapter/path, line/span), severity, category (grammar|garbled|style|wordiness|echo), message, suggestion, engine.
Commands load text through ingest and pass an empty finding list through to report stubs.

acceptance.derived_reason: derived 3 independently testable clauses from the task statement before product edit (#3323)
